pages.title: Organic Evaporite
pages.text: Crystals of benzene and ethane, and of acetylene and butane, left behind where a methane lake dried up - Titan's salt flats. Found in the evaporite crust of Titan's dry lake beds.

Made in $(item)Brine Evaporator$() and $(item)NMR Spectrometer$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Evaporite Deposit$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Catalyst Sprite, Cryolava Slug.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Abandoned Refinery, Cryolab chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Lakes of Titan.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Aramid Fibre, Chiral Ligand, Ethylene, Evaporite Crust, Kekule's Dream.
